summary.text: Allen Buansi is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 56 in Orange County since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as attorney.

paragraphs.text: Allen Buansi earned a bachelor's degree from Dartmouth College in 2009 and a law degree from the University of North Carolina School of Law in 2015, according to Ballotpedia.
He was appointed to the North Carolina House to replace Verla Insko (D) and assumed office on June 1, 2022.
The General Assembly lists 2.5 terms in the House for Buansi.
The Democratic primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
